description.value:
This +3 major striking greater decaying greater fearsome staff was crafted from the blackened spinal column of Cataphraxas, the giant viper companion of an ancient sekmin king. While wielding it, you gain a +1 circumstance bonus to skill checks to [[/act coerce]], [[/act make-an-impression]], [[/act request]], or [[/act lie]] to serpentfolk or other creatures who swear allegiance to the sekmin empire.

Activate—Spectral Serpents 2 (concentrate)

Frequency once per day

Effect A writhing knot of ghostly snakes uncoils from the head of the staff, lashing out to strike at 3 creatures within 60 feet. Each targeted creature takes @Damage[4d6[spirit],4d6[persistent,poison]] damage (@Check[reflex|dc:43|basic|options:inflicts:persistent-damage|traits:concentrate] save). A creature that critically fails its save is also @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.Slowed]{Slowed 1} as long as the persistent poison damage lasts.

Activate Cast a Spell

Effect You expend a number of charges from the staff to cast a spell from its list.

Cantrip @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.spells-srd.Item.Puff of Poison]

1st @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.spells-srd.Item.Animal Allies] (snakes only), @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.spells-srd.Item.Spider Sting]

2nd @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.spells-srd.Item.Hidebound], @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.spells-srd.Item.Mist]

3rd @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.spells-srd.Item.Enthrall], @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.spells-srd.Item.Hypnotize]

4th @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.spells-srd.Item.Snake Fangs], @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.spells-srd.Item.Translocate]

5th @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.spells-srd.Item.Mind Probe], @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.spells-srd.Item.Toxic Cloud]

6th @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.spells-srd.Item.Scrying], @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.spells-srd.Item.Vampiric Exsanguination]

7th @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.spells-srd.Item.Mask of Terror], @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.spells-srd.Item.Slither]

8th @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.spells-srd.Item.Eclipse Burst], @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.spells-srd.Item.Summon Undead]

9th @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.spells-srd.Item.Implosion], @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.spells-srd.Item.Seize Soul]

10th @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.spells-srd.Item.Summon Undead] (@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.book-of-the-dead-bestiary.Actor.Hollow Serpent] only)
